references.text: Describes the priests' portion of the grain offerings and the wave offering (terumah) that belongs to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right.
The priest who presents the blood sacrifice shall have the skin of the burnt offering as his share.
The breast and the right thigh of the peace offering shall belong to the priest as his share.
Establishes the priests' rights to portions of the sacrificial animals and the first fruits that the people bring.
Moses instructs Aaron and his sons to eat their portion of the offerings in a holy place.
Ezekiel confirms that the grain offering, sin offering, and guilt offering shall belong to the priests, as well as the first fruits.
Describes the wave offering and the heave offering that shall be the share of Aaron and his sons from the Israelites.
